title: Zephyrine and the Machine
premise: Elodie Galloway pilots the freighter Zephyrine along the Silent Corridor, a trade route abandoned by two warring human factions who split two hundred years ago over the ethics of mind-copying. Her cargo hold holds three hundred cryopods: backups of people from both worlds, entrusted to her family generations ago and never delivered. When a distress signal arrives in Old Common, the shared language both sides erased, Elodie traces it to a drifting ark where the original bodies of her backups still sleep. She must choose whether to wake the copies or the originals—knowing either choice erases half of humanity's memory—and she ends the war by refusing the binary, waking them together and forcing both worlds to share one future.
about_author: Casper Thackeray is the pen name of a former maritime radio operator who spent a decade listening to frequencies no one else answered. Their fiction explores the loneliness of long-distance signals and the families we inherit in cargo manifests.

chapters.title: The Long Quiet
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. She runs the Silent Corridor alone, trading between hostile ports that never acknowledge each other, while the cryopods hum in the hold. A routine delivery reveals both worlds have quietly stopped answering her messages. Emotional beat: the ache of chosen isolation beginning to crack.

chapters.title: A Voice in Dead Tongue
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. A distress signal arrives in Old Common, a language her grandmother taught her as a lullaby. She triangulates it to coordinates inside contested space. Emotional beat: wonder and dread—the first voice in years that isn't a transaction.

chapters.title: What the Hold Remembers
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV, intercut with log entries from her grandmother. Flashbacks reveal the pods are backups of people from both factions, including, she discovers, a backup of herself. Emotional beat: inheritance as burden, identity as question.

chapters.title: The Ark Adrift
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. She docks with the derelict ark Vesper and finds it crewed by one ancient custodian AI and four thousand original bodies in stasis—including the originals of her backups. Emotional beat: vertigo of meeting the source of your own reflection.

chapters.title: Two Names, One Face
chapters.summary: Dual POV: Elodie and the AI, Meridian. The AI explains the war's origin: each faction believes the other's copies are soulless, and delivering the pods would ignite genocide. Emotional beat: love against duty—Elodie begins falling for the recorded voice of her own backup.

chapters.title: Intercepted
chapters.summary: POV of Captain Rhee, a patrol officer from the Meridian faction who has secretly monitored Elodie for years. He boards the Zephyrine demanding the pods as evidence of the other side's crimes. Emotional beat: the watcher revealed, Elodie's invisibility weaponized against her.

chapters.title: The Arithmetic of Souls
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Held aboard her own ship, she bargains with Rhee while Meridian reveals the ark's reactor is failing—both pods and originals will die within days. Emotional beat: rising dread; every option costs a world.

chapters.title: What Elodie Chose
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. She wakes her own backup to negotiate with Rhee face to face—the living proof that copies are continuous persons. The two Elodies argue, grieve, and merge their memories. Emotional beat: identity resolved not as either/or but as both.

chapters.title: Signal Fire
chapters.summary: Multi-POV climax. Elodie broadcasts the Old Common distress signal to both homeworlds with proof of the ark's dying cargo, forcing factions to cooperate on rescue or be blamed for extinction. Rhee defects to help. Emotional beat: love and duty finally pointing the same direction.

chapters.title: Both Halves Waking
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. In orbit, copies and originals wake side by side; the two fleets hold fire to watch. Elodie, now plural in memory, delivers the pods home to a corridor that will speak again. Emotional beat: resolution—inheritance transformed from secret to bridge, and Elodie no longer invisible.
